subject: Re: Acme / Redwood — Mutual Action Plan & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Myers <jordan@acme.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Acme / Redwood — Mutual Action Plan & next steps

Hi Jordan — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call + proposed mutual action plan so we have aligned milestones and owners. I captured the pain, goals, decision process, and a timeline below. Please confirm or edit where needed.

Summary of pain & goals
- Pain: High per-token inference costs for Acme's recommendation service plus latency spikes during peak traffic. Current infra is a mix of CPU endpoints and small GPU instances; unacceptable tail latency for 99th percentile.
- Goal: Reduce per-request cost by ~40% while keeping 95th/99th percentile latency under 250ms for 1-2k RPS. Also ensure data residency and auditability for EU customers (Phase 2).

Key stakeholders (as discussed)
- Jordan Myers — Head of Product (decision influencer)
- Priya Shah — Procurement (budget/PO owner) — added to thread in your reply if possible
- Samir Patel — Infra Lead (technical evaluator) — will join the POC
- Marissa Cole (me) — AE lead / commercial touch
- Dylan Brooks — Solutions Engineer (technical POC)
- Marcus Lin — Customer Success (post-sign implementation)

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) — draft
1) POC kickoff: Redwood provides 2-week POC with a dedicated SLO and test harness.
   - Owner: Dylan Brooks (Redwood) / Samir Patel (Acme)
   - Target start: 2027-04-04
   - Deliverables: baseline perf/cost report, integration checklist, sample traffic replay

2) POC evaluation & optimization: run 2 weeks, iterate on batching, quantization profile, and caching.
   - Owner: Dylan Brooks / Samir Patel
   - Target review: 2027-04-18
   - Success criteria: 40% cost reduction vs baseline OR latency <250ms p99 under 1k RPS
3) Procurement & contracting
   - Owner: Priya Shah (Acme) / Marissa Cole (Redwood)
   - Target: PO issued by 2027-05-02
4) Pilot to prod rollout (Dedicated capacity reservation)
   - Owner: Marcus Lin / Samir Patel
   - Target: start 2027-05-16

Decision process & timeline
- Product team (Jordan) + Infra (Samir) to validate technical fit during POC.
- Procurement (Priya) to approve commercial terms after POC success.
- Exec sponsor sign-off if PO > $250k ARR.

Open questions from our call
- Data residency for EU customers: will require Redwood Private or Dedicated in EU region — Samir to confirm regulatory constraints.
- Expected peak RPS pattern and sample traffic: Jordan to share last 30 days of traffic by Wednesday.

Next steps (immediate)
- I will send a POC plan + calendar invite for the kickoff by EOD Monday (Mar 22).
- Jordan / Samir: please share the traffic sample and a low-level infra diagram this week.
- Priya: can you confirm procurement timeline so we can align contract milestones?

Attached: Acme_REDWOOD_MAP_MutualActionPlan_v1.xlsx (Excel, 45KB) - draft milestones table you can edit.

Thanks - looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0142

--
Redwood Inference — A platform for production LLM inference

From: Jordan Myers <jordan@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme / Redwood — Mutual Action Plan & next steps

Marissa - really appreciate the clear recap. This matches our notes. A few quick clarifications and one ask from Procurement: 

1) POC timing: 2027-04-04 kickoff works for us, but Samir asked if we can shift the review to 2027-04-20 (2 weeks + 2 days) to give his team time to validate logs. Is that OK on your side?

2) Success criteria: we prefer a phased success definition: Tier 1 - achieve cost reduction on non-peak traffic; Tier 2 - meet p99 latency under sustained peak. We'll mark final acceptance after Tier 2.

3) Procurement: Priya here - FYI our internal PO timeline is tight at month-end. We can commit to PO by 2027-05-05 if contract is close. Also please route the contract through our vendor portal (vendor-id: ACME-VEND-889).

4) Attachments / traffic: Samir will upload the traffic sample to the shared drive by end of Tue.

Minor edit to MAP: please add Samir as technical approver on the POC review step.

If the dates above are acceptable, I'll confirm Samir's participation and Priya will start the vendor onboarding.

Thanks,
Jordan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Myers <jordan@acme.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme / Redwood — Mutual Action Plan & next steps

Perfect - thanks for the quick reply and the procurement note, Priya. All edits accepted. Updated items below and next logistics: 

- POC review moved to 2027-04-20 (Samir added as technical approver).
- Acceptance: Tier 1 / Tier 2 phased acceptance added.
- Procurement: noted vendor-id ACME-VEND-889 - Marissa (me) will share a redline by 2027-04-25 to get you to final.

Next logistics / action items:
- Dylan will send the POC playbook and calendar invite for 2027-04-04 kickoff by EOD today.
- Jordan / Samir: please upload the traffic sample to the shared drive link (see MAP attachment) by Tue 2027-03-23 EOD - this will allow Dylan to start baseline runs.
- Priya: I'll add you to the contract thread and vendor onboarding checklist.

I'll update the attached MAP to v1.1 and share the Drive link once updated. Let me know if any other owners should be added.

Best,
Marissa
